reason: A browser-based voice-input utility for the DeepSeek Harness Web composer that converts speech into editable prompt text without automatically submitting it.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框添加麦克风按钮，将语音转换为可编辑的提示文本。
summaries.en: Adds a microphone button to the DeepSeek Harness web composer and converts speech into editable prompt text.

capabilities: Requests microphone permission after user activation
Uses the browser SpeechRecognition API to convert speech into editable draft text
Injects a microphone control and related status UI into the web composer
